description.en: How clearly you direct Codex through text — clarity, context, and course-correction.
description.zh: 你怎么用文字驱动 Codex — 清晰度、上下文、纠偏能力。

description.en: How well you drive the Codex platform — tools, durable project setup, steady tempo.
description.zh: 你把 Codex 平台用到几成 — 工具调度、持久化设置、推进节奏。

description.en: What actually gets shipped — efficiency, verification, and clean closure.
description.zh: 实际产出的质量 — 效率、验证、收尾干净度。

description.en: Whether your directives give Codex a concrete target — goal, expected behavior, file paths, constraints.
description.zh: 你的指令是否给了 Codex 一个具体目标 — 目标、期望行为、文件路径、约束。

lock_on.baselineFormula: 35 + directing.explicitGoal * 20 + directing.expectedBehavior * 18 + directing.filePath * 18 + directing.constraints * 10 + directing.errorLog * 8 - max(0, 90 - stats.averageHumanMessageLength) * 0.08, clamped [0, 100]. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.lock_on.

adjustmentGuide.upward: evidenceAtoms show terse but surgically precise instructions (file path + identifier + action in < 90 chars) — silent-expert precision, not low intent.
adjustmentGuide.downward: evidenceAtoms show long messages that still lack a clear deliverable — length without a target.

requiredEvidence: a keyMessage that names no file while asking for an edit
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Name the exact file/function in the ask: '修改 <path>: <function> — <expected behavior>'.

requiredEvidence: the correction incident that a stated constraint would have prevented
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: State the boundary up front: '…但不要动 <X>，保持 <Y> 不变'.

description.en: How much useful context your session-opening messages carry before Codex starts acting.
description.zh: Codex 动手之前，你每个会话的开场消息携带了多少有用的上下文。

scene_setting.baselineFormula: 30 + opening.expectedBehavior * 22 + opening.constraints * 16 + opening.filePath * 16 + opening.codeOrData * 14 + clamp(stats.averageHumanMessageLength / 7, 0, 12), clamped [0, 100]. The opening bucket is the first 2 messages of EACH session. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.scene_setting.

adjustmentGuide.upward: Opening messages consistently paste real project context (file trees, configs, error logs, code) even without triggering keyword matches.
adjustmentGuide.downward: Opening messages are long but generic — length without project-specific information.

requiredEvidence: an opening message that made Codex re-discover project state
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Open sessions with a 3-line scene: what changed since last time, what you want now, where it lives.

requiredEvidence: repeated context re-explained across session openings
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Move the repeated context into AGENTS.md so every session starts pre-briefed (pair with the architecture recipe).

description.en: Quality of mid-session course-correction and verification requests when Codex drifts.
description.zh: Codex 跑偏时，你纠偏和要求验证的质量。

steering.baselineFormula: 38 + directing.asksVerify * 20 + correctionSubstance * 16 + min(10, confirmShare * 30) + directing.errorLog * 8 - abortRatio * 12, clamped [0, 100]. correctionSubstance = share of corrections that carry a path/error/code (0.5 neutral when there are no corrections); confirmShare = confirming messages over all messages. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.steering.

adjustmentGuide.upward: evidenceAtoms show precise corrections with code/paths even without reasoning keywords (shows, doesn't tell).
adjustmentGuide.downward: Corrections are blunt ('no, wrong, redo') and never explain why — Codex can't learn from the feedback. Many aborted or silently dropped turns.

suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Correct with coordinates: '不对 — 问题在 <file/line>，现在是 <actual>，应该是 <expected>'.

requiredEvidence: an edit-heavy episode with zero verification asks
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: End work requests with a proof clause: '改完后跑 <test/build command>，把结果贴给我'.

description.en: How deliberately the collaboration uses the Codex platform — shell, patch, plan updates, MCP, search, subagents — and how reliably commands succeed.
description.zh: 协作中对 Codex 平台的有意使用 — shell、补丁、plan 更新、MCP、搜索、子代理 — 以及命令的成功率。

toolcraft.baselineFormula: 30 + min(20, count(byCategory) * 4) + commandSuccessRate * 18 + min(12, planUpdates * 3) + min(10, webSearchCalls + browserCalls + mcpCalls) + min(10, subagentCalls * 3), clamped [0, 100]. commandSuccessRate is 0.5 (neutral) when no command carried a readable exit code. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.toolcraft.
toolcraft.scoringPhilosophy: Using shell + apply_patch competently is the baseline. Plan updates, MCP, search, and subagents add bonuses on top. Reaching for advanced tools is rewarded; not reaching for them is not punished. Orchestration quality (spawned agents actually waited on and closed, plans actually completed) matters more than raw counts — use modernToolSummary for the adjustment.

adjustmentGuide.upward: workflowEpisodes show plan updates that led to substantive multi-file patches, subagent lifecycles that close cleanly (low orphanedEstimate), or MCP usage that advanced the work with a low error rate.
adjustmentGuide.downward: Many failed shell commands, orphaned subagents (spawned but never closed), plans that never progress past the first step, or advanced tools invoked with no follow-through — tool theater without leverage.

suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Close the loop on every spawn: after wait_agent returns, fold the result into the main thread and close_agent.

requiredEvidence: a multi-file episode that ran without a plan
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: For multi-file work, ask for a plan first: '先 update_plan 列步骤，我确认后再动手'.

requiredEvidence: top repeated web queries from modernToolSummary.web.topQueries
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: If the same domain keeps getting searched, wire the matching MCP server / docs source once instead.

description.en: Whether the project gives Codex durable context — AGENTS.md, .codex/.agents, git, manifests, README, tests.
description.zh: 项目是否为 Codex 提供了持久化的上下文 — AGENTS.md、.codex/.agents、git、依赖清单、README、测试。

architecture.baselineFormula: 25 + (hasAgentsMd ? 20 : 0) + ((hasCodexDir || hasAgentsDir) ? 12 : 0) + (hasGit ? 12 : 0) + (hasManifest ? 12 : 0) + (hasReadme ? 8 : 0) + (hasTestsDir ? 8 : 0) + min(8, rootEntryCount / 8), clamped [0, 100]. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.architecture.
architecture.applicabilityRule: If projectAssets.cwdResolved is false, this dimension is N/A — the recorded project directory could not be located on this machine, so filesystem inspection isn't possible.

adjustmentGuide.upward: AGENTS.md is present and the sessions show Codex relying on durable context (no re-explaining) — leverage across sessions.
adjustmentGuide.downward: No AGENTS.md and little structure — the openings show Codex re-learning the project every session.

requiredEvidence: conventions/commands repeated across sessions that belong in AGENTS.md
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Generate a project-specific AGENTS.md draft from the observed commands, conventions, and pitfalls in this project's sessions — ready to paste.

requiredEvidence: the edit volume shipping without a test harness
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Ask Codex to scaffold the smallest honest test harness for this stack and wire it to '<runner> test'.

description.en: Whether work advances steadily without excessive aborts, context compactions, errors, or tool churn.
description.zh: 工作是否稳步推进，没有过多的中断、上下文压缩、错误或工具空转。

tempo.baselineFormula: 72 - abortRatio * 28 - min(14, contextCompactions * 3) - min(12, errors * 3) + min(10, cleanEndRatio * 10) - max(0, toolsPerHumanMsg - 10) * 2, clamped [0, 100]. abortRatio counts explicit aborts AND silently dropped turns (started but never completed). Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.tempo.

adjustmentGuide.upward: workflowEpisodes show clean arcs (setup → build → verify → close) with few aborts and steady durations.
adjustmentGuide.downward: Episodes thrash — repeated aborts, retry churn incidents, many compactions, or huge tool-per-message counts without matching progress.

requiredEvidence: the churned command and its failure count
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: When a command fails twice, stop the loop: '这条命令连续失败了，先诊断原因再重试'.

requiredEvidence: the compaction count and session durations
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Split long sessions at natural milestones — start a fresh thread with a 3-line handoff instead of riding one thread into compaction.

description.en: How much useful output per human message and per tool call — edits, distinct files, command success.
description.zh: 每条人类消息、每次工具调用产出的有效工作 — 编辑、覆盖文件、命令成功率。

efficiency.baselineFormula: 35 + min(24, editsPerHumanMsg * 18) + min(16, filesPerHumanMsg * 18) + commandSuccessRate * 12 + cleanEndRatio * 10 - max(0, toolsPerHumanMsg - 12) * 2, clamped [0, 100]. commandSuccessRate is 0.5 (neutral) when unmeasurable. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.efficiency.

adjustmentGuide.upward: workflowEpisodes show a session that closed a task in 1-3 messages with multiple file edits — silent-expert efficiency.
adjustmentGuide.downward: High tool use but few distinct files touched — busywork, not real progress.

requiredEvidence: an episode with heavy tool use and few edits
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Scope the exploration: '先只看 <dir/file>，确认 <question>，别展开全仓库扫描'.

description.en: How consistently the work is backed by proof — tests, builds, lint that actually ran (and passed), or explicit verification asks.
description.zh: 工作有多大程度被验证兜底 — 真正跑过（且通过）的测试、构建、lint，或明确的验证请求。

proof_check.baselineFormula: 28 + min(34, proofCommands.passed * 8 + proofCommands.failed * 4 + proofCommands.unknown * 2) + directing.asksVerify * 18 + (hasTestsDir ? 8 : 0) + min(12, browserCalls + viewImageCalls), clamped [0, 100]. Only real verification runners count as proof (npm test, pytest, tsc, …) — `echo 验证` does not; image generation never counts, only inspection (view/screenshot). Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.proof_check.

adjustmentGuide.upward: Proof commands pass and the user reacts to failures (a failed test followed by a fix and a re-run is excellent behavior).
adjustmentGuide.downward: Implementation work with no test/build/check anywhere — shipped on faith.

requiredEvidence: the absence of any proof run
suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: 改完后运行 <detected test/build command for this stack> 并把结果贴给我，失败就先修复再收工。
Make green the exit condition: '直到 <runner> 全绿才算完成，每轮贴摘要'.

description.en: Whether turns finish cleanly with a clear result rather than being left mid-turn or aborted.
description.zh: 回合是否带着明确结果干净收尾，而不是停在半途或被中断。

completion.baselineFormula: 45 + cleanEndRatio * 35 + min(10, (agentMessages / max(1, turnCompletes)) * 3) - abortRatio * 18 - min(8, errors * 2), clamped [0, 100]. cleanEndRatio = completed turns over started turns; silently dropped turns count against it. Computed by the parser as facts.computedBaselines.completion.

adjustmentGuide.upward: workflowEpisodes show turns consistently completing with a final agent message and no abandoned aborts.
adjustmentGuide.downward: Turns trail off or get aborted mid-work without resolution.

suggestionRecipes.promptPattern: Before abandoning a turn, bank the state: '先停一下，总结当前进度和下一步，写进 <notes file>'.

scoring.baselineSource: facts.computedBaselines — the parser computes each dimension's baselineFormula deterministically and applies confidence scaling. Do NOT recompute formulas by hand; read computedBaselines.<id>.confidenceScaled as the starting score.

adjustmentRange.note: Maximum ± adjustment depends on facts.confidenceLevel — thin data earns less discretionary movement.

scoring.adjustmentRequirement: Must cite specific evidenceAtoms / workflowEpisodes / criticalIncidents (by id where available) in reasoning. No evidence → adjustment = 0.

confidenceScaling.note: Already applied by the parser inside computedBaselines (low: 50+(b-50)*0.75, medium: 50+(b-50)*0.9, high: unchanged). Surface a 'limited data' note when confidenceLevel is low.

naHandling.rule: A dimension is N/A when computedBaselines.<id>.applicable is false (profile naDimensions or applicabilityRule). N/A dimensions have score=null, grade=null, applicable=false, and are excluded from category and overall averages.

scoring.categoryScore: Average of the applicable dimensions in the category, rounded.
scoring.overallScore: Weighted sum of category scores using projectProfile.categoryWeights, renormalized over categories that have a score. Rounded.
scoring.overallGradeNote: Show the project profile next to the grade — an 'automation' B is not a 'long-running' B.

description.en: You and Codex are perfectly in sync — seamless, high-leverage flow.
description.zh: 你和 Codex 完美同步，协作高效精准。

description.en: Strong collaboration instincts — smooth and efficient most of the time.
description.zh: 很好的协作直觉，大部分时候配合流畅。

description.en: Finding your rhythm — clear room to grow with specific improvements.
description.zh: 正在找到节奏，进步空间明确。

description.en: Freestyle and intuitive — a bit of structure would go a long way.
description.zh: 偏自由随性，加一些结构会让效果翻倍。

description.en: Everyone starts here — small changes lead to big improvements.
description.zh: 每个人都从这里开始，小改变带来大提升。

automation.note: Most sessions are non-interactive `codex exec` runs. Communication dimensions judge the prompt templates; Steering is N/A because single-turn runs cannot be course-corrected. The report should state the automation share plainly.

diagnosis.purpose: Independent of scoring. Turns the numbers into an actionable, evidence-grounded read of how this user works with Codex.

components.description: 120-180 words describing how this user collaborates with Codex. Reference real behavior from evidenceAtoms, workflowEpisodes, and modernToolSummary (message style, tool usage, orchestration, proof habits). No personality archetypes.
60-100 words naming the single strongest strength and the single most critical bottleneck, each with evidence and the concrete cost of the bottleneck.
1-2 sentences interpreting how the dimension scores combine (e.g. 'high Lock-On + low Proof Check = you trust Codex's execution but not its judgment').

constraints: Every claim cites evidence from evidenceAtoms (by id), workflowEpisodes, criticalIncidents, modernToolSummary, or the tool/outcome totals.
Describe observable behavior, not personality. No fortune-teller tone.
If selfBaseline is present, anchor at least one claim against the user's own typical session ('half the proof density of your median session').
Bilingual parity (en/zh) — same meaning, not a literal translation.

insight.description: ONE vivid 60-110 char hero line (bilingual) — a coach's wake-up call the user instantly recognizes. Often a tension (strong-X but weak-Y).

observations.purpose: Step 1 of suggestion generation. Before writing suggestions, list 8-12 grounded observations — each a single sentence stating a real, specific behavior pattern with evidenceRefs pointing at evidenceAtoms/criticalIncidents ids. Suggestions are then instantiated from the strongest observations.

suggestions.count: MINIMUM 5, maximum 7. Never fewer than 5, even for high-scoring users.

types.prompt_rewrite: A better way to phrase the ask. Payload: promptRewrite (pastable string).
types.workflow_habit: A repeatable multi-step habit. Payload: steps (3-5 concrete bullet strings) + optional promptRewrite.
types.setup_action: A durable investment in the project. Payload: snippet (file content or shell command ready to paste) + optional steps.
types.tool_adoption: A platform capability the user is leaving on the table. Payload: steps (how to wire it + first concrete use) + optional promptRewrite.
types.verification_loop: A definition-of-done ritual. Payload: promptRewrite (the closing clause) + verifyBy.

suggestions.typeMix: When the facts support it, at least 2 of the 5-7 suggestions must be non-prompt_rewrite types. Do not force it on genuinely conversation-only projects.

priorityMapping.B (55-69): medium (upgrade to high if clearly poor)
priorityMapping.S (85-100): low (refinement to lock in the strength, or cross-pollinate to weaker dims)

suggestions.recipesFirst: Check each dimension's suggestionRecipes triggers against the facts FIRST. A fired recipe becomes a suggestion instantiated with this user's real files, commands, and messages. Only invent free-form suggestions when no recipe fires or the evidence points somewhere the recipes don't cover.
highScorerFillSources: Within a strong dimension — push from 82 → 90+ with a next-level habit.
Cross-pollinate — apply a habit working in one dimension to a weaker one.
Platform leverage — a specific plan / subagent / MCP / proof move tied to the actual workflow observed in modernToolSummary.
Durable setup — AGENTS.md, tests, repo scaffolding the user hasn't invested in.
Risk reduction — even strong scoring can hide brittleness (e.g. ships with no tests).
required: body (bilingual, 2-4 sentences: current behavior → its cost → what to change)
evidence (bilingual, 1-2 sentences quoting/paraphrasing real session content)
evidenceRefs (>= 2 ids from evidenceAtoms/criticalIncidents; 1 allowed only when the facts genuinely contain a single relevant atom)
verifyBy (bilingual — which facts metric should move on the next radar run, e.g. 'proofCommands.passed > 0')
principles: Anti-generic rule: if the suggestion still makes sense after deleting every project-specific noun (file, command, tool, message), rewrite it until it doesn't.
No empty platitudes. Not 'verify more' — instead 'After the change, run <the detected test command> and paste me the result.'
Sort: high → medium → low; within a priority, by impact scope (largest first).
Every suggestion names at least one real noun from this project: a file, a command, a tool, or a quoted message fragment.
